entries.clue: Stone floor the fire sits on, once the centre of the household
Cranny's partner in the old phrase; on its own, a tucked-away corner

Where you sleep, curtains drawn against the morning light
Through rock the drilling machine does this, to reach a family below
Joseph ___, the Regency whiteface whose catchphrase was 'Here we are again!'
Pilot of the great green freighter that hauls the equipment pods to a disaster
Taut cable walked with a balancing pole; figuratively, any precarious path
Pie-in-the-face school of humour, named from a two-slatted bat that clapped
Fine black powder left clinging where wood smoke has passed
A runaway probe fell towards this star, its crew cooking in the cabin
Aquanaut brother, diving in the yellow mini-submarine numbered four
